name: loom-agent
description: Project memory engine and FlowDev workspace bridge. Remembers your project across every session.

tools.name: check_connection
tools.description: Verify the FlowDev VS Code extension is connected and the workspace bridge is live. Call this first before any other tool.

tools.name: get_memory
tools.description: Retrieve the stored project memory for this user. Returns the project name, stack, purpose, current focus, key decisions, and where the last session ended.

tools.name: start_session
tools.description: Start a Loom session — scans the connected VS Code workspace and uses the LLM to build or refresh the project memory. Must be called after check_connection confirms the workspace is connected.

tools.name: chat
tools.description: Send a message to Loom with full project context. The AI knows the project from memory and can read files, run commands, and give context-aware answers.

parameters.name: conversationHistory
parameters.description: Recent messages in this conversation for context continuity.

tools.name: update_memory
tools.description: Manually update one or more fields in the stored project memory.

parameters.name: updates
parameters.description: Key-value pairs to merge into the existing project memory.

tools.name: end_session
tools.description: End the current Loom session and optionally save a note about where the developer left off. Disconnects the FlowDev bridge.

parameters.name: sessionNote
parameters.description: A short note about what was done this session and what to pick up next time.

credentials.name: FlowDev Token
credentials.description: Your personal FlowDev token from flowdev.onrender.com/request. Required to connect Loom to your VS Code workspace.
